feedMatrices.name: Specialty Green Arabica Coffee Beans (11.2% Moisture, 175 mg Bean Weight)
feedMatrices.description: Raw unroasted coffee beans susceptible to Ochratoxin A fungal contamination. Dielectric core penetration ensures expansion and puffing of the cellulose cell matrix from inside-out, providing explosive aroma release with zero bean tipping or scorched face defects.

feedMatrices.name: Fermented & Dried Trinitario Cacao Beans (7.5% Moisture, 52% Cacao Butter)
feedMatrices.description: Fermented cocoa beans with delicate outer husks. Spouted bed fluidization gently lifts beans without mechanical tumbling friction, preventing nib shattering while microwave energy drives Maillard synthesis of chocolate aldehydes and pyrazines.

feedMatrices.name: Whole Shelled California Nonpareil Almonds (5.8% Moisture, 49% Lipids)
feedMatrices.description: Raw almonds requiring validated 4.0-log Salmonella enterica lethality. Spouted bed heating uniformly roasts kernels without scorching delicate skins, preserving vitamin E tocopherols and suppressing lipid peroxidation.

feedMatrices.name: Whole Natural Organic Sesame Seeds (6.5% Moisture, High Lignan Content)
feedMatrices.description: Fine, high-oil seeds that easily scorch in conventional revolving roasters. Spouted aerodynamic fluidization suspends seeds in a turbulent vortex, while induction heat rapidly develops nutty sesamol notes in <90 seconds.

feedMatrices.name: Whole Hull-less Food Barley Grains (12.4% Moisture, High Beta-Glucan)
feedMatrices.description: Cereal grain for health flours and hot breakfast cereals. Volumetric microwave heating gelatinizes starches uniformly and inactivates endogenous lipases, preventing bitter rancidity during subsequent shelf storage.

microwaveCavityConditions.rfShieldingCompliance: FCC Title 47 CFR Part 18 Compliant (< 0.2 mW/cm² at 5 cm)
microwaveCavityConditions.description: Advanced solid-state RF generation delivering precise, closed-loop impedance matching. Penetrates deep into cellular bean moisture, vaporizing internal pore water and expanding the bean structure without surface scorching.

microwaveCavityConditions.name: High-Power Industrial 915 MHz Single-Cavity Waveguide (Deep Volumetric Penetration)
microwaveCavityConditions.waveguideType: Heavy-Duty WR975 Waveguide with Water-Cooled Magnetron Launch
microwaveCavityConditions.rfShieldingCompliance: FCC Part 18 & OSHA 1910.97 Compliant (< 0.5 mW/cm² at 5 cm)
microwaveCavityConditions.description: Lower frequency, ultra-deep penetration microwave cavity designed for large bulk kernels (such as whole walnuts, macadamias, and large cacao beans) requiring uniform core pasteurization throughout thick cross-sections.

microwaveCavityConditions.name: Microsecond Pulsed 2.45 GHz Microwave Cavity (Non-Thermal Electroporation Synergy)
microwaveCavityConditions.waveguideType: Pulsed Resonant Cavity with High-Peak Magnetron Driver
microwaveCavityConditions.description: High-peak pulsed electromagnetic field delivering rapid dielectric pore rupture in bacterial spores and fungal cell membranes while minimizing cumulative thermal bulk heating.

microwaveCavityConditions.waveguideType: Damaged Unshielded Flange with Defective Choke Seals

inductionHeatingStages.name: High-Frequency Induction Coils (25–40 kHz) with Microprocessor Skin-Effect Current Control
inductionHeatingStages.description: Precision water-cooled copper induction coils positioned around the outer stainless/Inconel conical spouted vessel. Generates rapid eddy currents within the vessel wall for instantaneous, uniform boundary heat transfer without combustion exhaust fumes.

inductionHeatingStages.name: Medium-Frequency Concentric Induction Jacket (10–20 kHz) with Thermal Barrier Tiles
inductionHeatingStages.description: Deep-penetration magnetic induction jacket suited for heavy wall Duplex stainless vessels, offering steady, heavy-duty thermal output during continuous 24/7 grain sanitation runs.

inductionHeatingStages.name: Conventional Direct Natural Gas Burner Flame (High Scorching & Carbon Monoxide Hazard)
inductionHeatingStages.description: Outdated fossil combustion heating with severe hot spots (>280°C contact patches), high scorched-spot defect rate (4–8%), dangerous CO/NOx emissions, and high fire hazard in agricultural dust atmospheres.

technicalStandards.title: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels & High-Temperature Processing Chambers
technicalStandards.requirement: Mandates vessel wall thicknesses, thermal stress relief calculations, nozzle reinforcement, and dual pressure safety valves for vessels operating with pressurized air and high-temperature induction fields.

technicalStandards.title: Industrial, Scientific, and Medical (ISM) Microwave Equipment Radiation Limits
technicalStandards.requirement: Governs electromagnetic emissions for industrial microwave processing at 2.45 GHz and 915 MHz. Specifies continuous shielding with electromagnetic radiation leakage < 5.0 mW/cm² measured at 5 cm from all external surfaces.

technicalStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Continuous Thermal Processing Equipment & Vessels
technicalStandards.requirement: Requires product-contact surfaces to possess a minimum surface roughness of Ra ≤ 0.8 µm (electropolished Ra ≤ 0.38 µm), completely drainable bottom cones, sanitary clamp connections, and clean-in-place (CIP) spray ball integration.

technicalStandards.title: Standard on the Fundamentals of Combustible Dust & Explosion Prevention in Food Processing
technicalStandards.requirement: Demands continuous electrostatic grounding, flameless explosion venting, fast-acting isolation valves, in-line optical spark detection, and emergency chamber inerting for processing grain dusts.

technicalStandards.title: Occupational Safety Standard for Nonionizing Radiation Exposure
technicalStandards.requirement: Sets industrial worker electromagnetic field (EMF) exposure thresholds, continuous interlock safety shutdowns if wave leakage exceeds 1.0 mW/cm², and warning signage for microwave-assisted roasting equipment.
